GOV-F-003-S27.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
GOV-F-003-S27.description: Define and implement the lock document schema including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status. Enforce contract validation for all lock operations.

GOV-F-003-S28.title: Atomic Lock Acquisition with TTL Enforcement
GOV-F-003-S28.description: Implement atomic lock acquisition logic using MongoDB with TTL-aware conditions to prevent race conditions and ensure only one owner can hold the lock at a time.

GOV-F-003-S29.title: Lock API for Acquire, Renew, Release
GOV-F-003-S29.description: Expose internal service functions or endpoints for lock acquire, renew (extend TTL), and release operations with strict ownership validation and error handling.

GOV-F-003-S30.title: Integration with Brain Loop Execution Cycle
GOV-F-003-S30.description: Integrate lock lifecycle (acquire, heartbeat/renew, release) into brain_loop execution to ensure continuous ownership during long-running operations and safe recovery on interruption.
